name: Domain Loyalty
body:
You are rewarded when you prepare domain spells from just one domain.

Prerequisite(s): Domain class feature, access to more than one domain, ability to prepare 3rd level domain spells.

Benefit: Whenever you prepare domain spells from just one domain you gain a special benefit until the next time you prepare spells. You can cast these spells freely without any fear of losing this ability. The exact ability granted by this feat varies with each domain.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you do it applies to a different domain.
